notes: Radar: 400 frames (top-5/az + Open3D ICP). LiDAR: 800 frames (KISS-ICP). RPE delta=10 m. APE with SE(3) Umeyama alignment vs Applanix.
resume_line: Built 2D radar odometry (CFAR keypoints + ICP) on Navtech radar from Boreas sequence boreas-2021-09-02-11-42 and compared it with a KISS-ICP LiDAR baseline against the Applanix GNSS/INS ground truth. Radar drift: 4.5% vs LiDAR: 1.3% (evo RPE @ 10 m); ATE 3.16 m vs 0.29 m.
